# Verification Requirements Quality Checklist: UA-F09 — Experience verification runner and evidence schema

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of UA-F09: completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability,
lifecycle and failure coverage, privacy and no-advertising constraints, accessibility, the split between
simulator-verifiable and device-only requirements, and traceability to the sources.
**Created**: 2026-11-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: Evaluated by the lead under the owner's standing delegation (2026-11-12). `[x]` means the
requirements-quality criterion is satisfied; it does not mean implementation work is complete. Items that
failed were corrected in the specification before this file was written; the correction is named in the item.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all nine standard scenarios named and each given a pass condition? [Completeness, Spec §FR-U09-001, Auto-Creator 22.1]
- [x] CHK002 Are the extra scenarios of creative experiences and games (fixtures, full-playthrough, hero, 80 acceptance, 50 fault cases, endurance) specified with their counts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-U09-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are every field and field group of evidence schema version 1 listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-U09-030]
- [x] CHK004 Are the driver's options (`--only`, `--skip`, `--scenario`, `--runtime`, `--audits`, `--self-test`) all specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-U09-021]
- [x] CHK005 Are all audits of the brief and the three further audits of section 22.2 assigned? [Completeness, Spec §FR-U09-050 to 055, Clarification 2]
- [x] CHK006 Is the outcome concept that the completion scenario needs specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-U09-004, Clarification 1]
- [x] CHK007 Are the carried obligations of UA-F06 (endurance) and UA-F07 (several ids) recorded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-U09-060, §FR-U09-061]
- [x] CHK008 Is a minimum number of probes per experience specified, so that "each probe it declares" cannot be zero? [Gap → corrected: FR-U09-040 now requires at least one probe]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Are the exit codes of the app's run (0, 1, 2) and their meanings defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-U09-011]
- [x] CHK010 Are the time limits of the driver quantified? [Ambiguity → corrected: FR-U09-024 now names 120 s per scenario, endurance time plus 120 s, 300 s boot, 540 s test runs]
- [x] CHK011 Is "no growth over its cycles" defined by a measurable rule and a minimum cycle count? [Ambiguity → corrected: FR-U09-014 names the UA-F06 growth rule and at least 5 cycles]
- [x] CHK012 Is the marker rule precise enough to separate "placeholder" as a technical term from a visible placeholder? [Clarity, Spec §FR-U09-050, Clarification 4]
- [x] CHK013 Is "pass without observed evidence" defined field by field? [Clarity, Spec §FR-U09-032, data-model §4]
- [x] CHK014 Is the location of the app's record, and who removes it, specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-U09-034, Clarification 3]
- [x] CHK015 Is the id of the debug experience on the command line defined? [Ambiguity → corrected: FR-U09-061 defines `debug` and the record's code]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK016 Is the two-launch save-restore requirement consistent with the sample's single-process package path? [Conflict → corrected: FR-U09-013 distinguishes the app path from the package path and marks the latter `single`]
- [x] CHK017 Do the scenario names agree between the spec, the clarifications and Auto-Creator 22.1? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK018 Is the request trigger (launch environment only) consistent with "no URL, file, argument or other outside input"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-U09-011, §FR-U09-012]
- [x] CHK019 Are the game counts consistent between story 8, FR-U09-005, FR-U09-053 and the planning catalog (80, 50, 100)? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK020 Does the evidence location agree with section 22.3 (tracked summaries, untracked raw files)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-U09-033]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK021 Are the success criteria countable (9 of 9, 2 runtimes, at least 12 invalid kinds, 4 planted defects, limit plus 30 s)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-U09-001 to 010]
- [x] CHK022 Does every user story have an independent test and acceptance scenarios? [Acceptance Criteria]
- [x] CHK023 Does the deliberately failing scenario have a named, checkable expected failure? [Measurability, Spec §SC-U09-002, §FR-U09-025]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK024 Are failure, crash and unknown-id cases of a scenario run specified with their outcome? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-U09-011]
- [x] CHK025 Are cancellation and lifecycle interruption covered? [Coverage, Spec §FR-U09-014, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK026 Is a damaged or newer manifest or record covered? [Coverage, Spec §FR-U09-002, §FR-U09-032]
- [x] CHK027 Is a simulator that refuses to launch, and concurrent driver runs, addressed? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK028 Is resumption after an interrupted run specified and measurable? [Coverage, Spec §FR-U09-021, §SC-U09-005]

## Non-Functional, Privacy, Accessibility

- [x] CHK029 Is the absence of the runner from the shipping build specified with a measurable check? [Security, Spec §FR-U09-012, §SC-U09-004]
- [x] CHK030 Is the absence of hardware identifiers from tracked files required and measurable? [Privacy, Spec §FR-U09-022, §SC-U09-010]
- [x] CHK031 Are no-network, no-advertising and no-tracking constraints stated? [Privacy, Spec §FR-U09-064]
- [x] CHK032 Is the effect on accessibility of the shipping app stated? [Gap → corrected: FR-U09-064 states the runner has no screen of its own and leaves the app's accessibility unchanged]
- [x] CHK033 Are simulator pacing, thermal and battery values marked as development signals, never device claims? [Non-Functional, Spec Assumptions]
